Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 06-Jan-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.Tech. (CORE & CSE STREAM) DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2024 / JANUARY 2025  
  SUBJECT: CIE 1072/CIE_1072 - ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES  
  (MAKEUP/REGULAR)  
  
  
  ENVIRONMENTAL STUDIES [CIE 1072]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                       Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)                Explain tragedy of commons with two examples.                                                          (5)  
1B)                "The EKC is right if you take countries in isolation but very wrong when taken for the whole world"-   (3)  
  explain the statement.  
1C)                Write down two environmental consequences of Ballari mining scam.                                      (2)  
2A)                Discuss soil horizon profile with a neat diagram.                                                      (5)  
2B)                Discuss India's water resource scenario.                                                               (3)  
2C)                What are the long-term consequences of Green revolution?                                               (2)  
3A)                Discuss the control strategies to reduce air pollution.                                                (5)  
3B)                Describe the potential effect of pollutant on Plants.                                                  (3)  
3C)                Explain how plastic waste can be used for making roads.                                                (2)  
4A)                Discuss the provisions made in environmental legislations to manage hazardous waste and its ill        (5)  
  effects.  
4B)                Discuss the benefits expected out of Sidhi landscape restoration project                               (3)  
4C)                Discuss the environmental legislation taken towards protection of forest and wildlife in India.        (2)  
5A)                With the help of a neat sketch explain the mechanism of Bottom Pressure Recorder (BPR) network (5)  
  during tsunamis.  
5B)                Explain with the help of a flowchart the National disaster management institutional mechanism          (3)  
5C)                Explain the Seismic zone map of India - 2002 in assessing seismic hazard damage.                       (2)  
  
  
  -----End-----
